Matas Buzelis' slam pulled the Bulls within seven, but Kasparas Jakucionis and Rollins hit consecutive treys to build the margin to 44-31 with 8:35 left in the first half. Chicago answered again and took a 55-51 lead on Hield's 3-pointer, which stamped a 16-0 run. Kuzma made a layup with three seconds left in the first half to give the Bucks a 62-61 halftime edge. --Field Level Media

item.title: UK government sets out $800 million of AI security funding
item.description: Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence. The biggest chunk of funding will go to a new biosecurity initiative, including £100 million for a laboratory using AI to detect biological threats and £65 million to develop countermeasures against pathogens. AI minister Kanishka Narayan said the aim was for the AI Biosecurity Lab to become a major global institution "bringing together world-leading scientific expertise to protect people from emerging biological threats". Tech companies OpenAI and Anthropic will offer up to £200 million of model credits to the biosecurity initiative Google Deepmind (GOOGL.O) and London-based AI life sciences startup Basecamp Research will offer other assistance Britain's government will give its existing [USN:L8N45E18S TEXT:"AI Security Institute"] an extra £120 million £130 million will go towards new projects to improve cyber defences for critical infrastructure and the wider economy, known as the National Cyber Shield and the National Exposure and Real-Time Vulnerability Centre £60 million will go towards a fund that will invest in British companies using AI to advance robotics, autonomous systems and manufacturing £60 million will be used for AI research and procurement contracts An extra £23 million will go to research on the economic impact of AI £18 million will go to a new chip design academy £15 million will fund a prize for AI solutions to public policy problems, initially focused on healthcare £30 million will go to regional mayors to support local AI work Britain's [USN:L8N42P1O5 TEXT:"National Cyber Security Centre"] will receive an unspecified sum to expand in Manchester Anthropic alone racked up [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"more than $12 billion in operating expenses"] last year ($1 = 0.7472 pounds)

item.title: Thailand welcomes US-Myanmar engagement, expects ASEAN talks on country's future
item.description: Thailand welcomes US engagement with Myanmar and expects discussions at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations' November summit in Manila on how to proceed with the member barred since the 2021 coup, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow told Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
item.content:encoded: Thailand welcomes US engagement with Myanmar and expects discussions at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations' November summit in Manila on how to proceed with the member barred since the 2021 coup, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow told Reuters on Friday. The United States and Myanmar's military-backed government held [USN:L6N46300W TEXT:"talks in Tokyo"] two weeks ago, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it shunned after the coup. "We don't want to see Myanmar isolated, we don't want Myanmar to be an arena for geopolitical rivalry ... so the US engagement is something that we welcome," he said. Engagement "does not mean legitimizing the regime," but aims to encourage peaceful conflict resolution and reconciliation with the opposition, Sihasak, who is also deputy prime minister, added. He said there was "some shift in ASEAN's position," citing Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing's recent visits to Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia, but said it was unclear whether the Manila summit would address restoring Myanmar's full representation. "It's good that we're going to have a very substantive, very extensive, and very in-depth discussion on how to proceed on Myanmar," he said. He also said Thailand and Cambodia could resolve their longstanding land and maritime boundary disputes within 12 to 18 months despite limited progress. "It is possible, everything is possible," he said, cautioning that confidence-building and addressing security concerns along the land border, where clashes have occurred, must come first. Cambodia launched a conciliation process under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea in June to resolve the maritime boundary dispute, after Thailand terminated a 2001 joint development framework in May following deadly border clashes. The first meeting was held about a month ago. "Right now, we haven't achieved, to be very frank, much progress," he said. The maritime dispute centers on overlapping claims to about 26,000 sq km in the Gulf of Thailand, believed to hold oil and gas reserves worth around $300 billion. Thailand wants the boundary defined before discussing resource-sharing, he said. Thailand-EU free-trade talks are in their final stage and could conclude by year-end if there is mutual political will, he added.

item.title: Time for Canadian newcomers to step into spotlight, says Ruggiero
item.description: Canada are entering a critical rebuilding phase ahead of next month's ice hockey Women's World Championship, retired US great Angela Ruggiero told Reuters, after falling to the US in the Milano Cortina Olympic gold medal game.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Canada are entering a critical rebuilding phase ahead of next month's ice hockey Women's World Championship, retired US great Angela Ruggiero told Reuters, after falling to the US in the Milano Cortina Olympic gold medal game. Canada have often had the upper hand in the countries' rivalry, with five Olympic golds to three for the US. But US youth conquered Canadian experience in Milano Cortina, as an American roster loaded with [USN:L8N3Z02EC TEXT:"collegiate talent"] held off the veterans from the north in a spine-tingling finale. Eight months later, Canada announced a World Championship roster with seven tournament debutants at the worlds, with an eye towards replicating US success in developing young up-and-comers. "They're going with a very young team, an inexperienced team that could really work in their favour," said Ruggiero, speaking to Reuters at the Women's Sports Foundation annual gala this week. "They're building for four years from now. So it was a strategic decision." The Hall of Famer helped propel the US to four world golds and made her Olympic debut at 18 years old, when the Americans took the first-ever women's ice hockey gold at the 1998 Games. She said Canada's youth corps should not be underestimated. "I think back to the 2008 World Championship team. We were a very, very young team. And we believed in ourselves. We were able to win those World Championships because of the psychology in the locker room, even though on the ice we weren't the best team," said Ruggiero. "If I were Canada's GM, I think it's the smartest thing to do. Reset the clock, figure out chemistry." The World Championship begins on November 6 after a memorable Milano Cortina Olympics, with the advent of the Professional Women's Hockey League in North America bringing the game into [USN:L8N3ZC0ZU TEXT:"a new era"]. "It was probably all around the most elite, highest skilled, fastest, best brand of women's hockey I have ever seen," said Meghan Duggan, Ruggiero's 2010 Olympic teammate who also appeared at the WSF gala in support of women's sports. "That shows what the professional league is doing to elevate the game."

item.title: Fever GM Amber Cox follows team president out of Indy
item.description: Fever general manager Amber Cox followed team president Kelly Krauskopf out the door in a major shakeup of the front office on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fever general manager Amber Cox followed team president Kelly Krauskopf out the door in a major shakeup of the front office on Friday. Kraskopf resigned earlier in the day and Cox was let go hours later, with the Fever saying the franchise was announcing "the departure of Amber Cox." The franchise wrapped up its best regular season in team history with 26 wins and went to the conference semifinals in Cox's first season in the GM role. Indiana had three players named WNBA All-Stars and two of the league's top three scorers in Kelsey Mitchell (second) and Caitlin Clark. Mitchell is a pending free agent and said she will shop around to find the best fit for her and her family this offseason. Mel Raines, president and CEO of Pacers Sports & Entertainment, said a national search is underway to fill the front-office spots. "Through her two seasons with the Fever, Amber has helped us navigate the seismic growth of the WNBA and our franchise," Raines said. "We're grateful for her contributions and wish her the very best moving forward." --Field Level Media

item.title: Ronaldinho voltará aos gramados pelo italiano Ravenna
item.description: O craque brasileiro Ronaldinho Gaúcho voltará ao futebol competitivo no próximo mês, quando jogará pelo Ravenna, time da terceira divisão italiana, contra o rival local Forlì, no dia 15 de novembro, anunciou o clube da Série C nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O craque brasileiro Ronaldinho Gaúcho voltará ao futebol competitivo no próximo mês, quando jogará pelo Ravenna, time da terceira divisão italiana, contra o rival local Forlì, no dia 15 de novembro, anunciou o clube da Série C nesta sexta-feira. O ex-atacante do Barcelona e do Milan, de 46 anos, que conquistou a Copa do Mundo de 2002 com o Brasil e a Bola de Ouro em 2005, jogou pela última vez em competições oficiais pelo Fluminense, em 2015. Ele se aposentou oficialmente em 2018. O Ravenna contratou Ronaldinho em junho e, posteriormente, ele adquiriu uma participação no clube, que é de propriedade de seu amigo Ignazio Cipriani. Cipriani disse que a iniciativa tinha como objetivo “aproximar toda a cidade do time”. Ronaldinho Gaúcho não chegou a confirmar que jogaria quando chegou à Itália em agosto, embora tenha deixado em aberto a possibilidade de marcar o 300º gol de sua carreira. “Estou aqui para ajudar”, disse ele na ocasião. O clássico contra o Forì será disputado no Stadio Bruno Benelli, em Ravenna. O Ravenna ocupa a segunda colocação do Grupo B da Série C, com 20 pontos em 10 partidas, oito pontos atrás do líder, o Spezia.

item.title: Oregon State breakout WR Jesse Legree re-signs with school for 2027
item.description: Oregon State star freshman receiver Jesse Legree announced Friday that he has re-signed with the Beavers for the 2027 season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oregon State star freshman receiver Jesse Legree announced Friday that he has re-signed with the Beavers for the 2027 season. Legree made the announcement at his former high school, Saint Frances Academy in Baltimore, partly because he was lightly recruited and didn't have a signing day a year ago. "We've built a great culture and it's only going to get bigger from here," Legree told ESPN. "This is going to be the start of a national powerhouse." The 5-foot-10, 172-pound Legree was only a three-star recruit but has exploded onto the scene in Corvallis. He leads the nation with 1,040 receiving yards and 14 touchdown receptions. He is two touchdown catches away from matching the school record held by longtime NFL receiver Brandin Cooks (16 in 2013). Legree has topped 100 yards receiving in all seven games for Oregon State (5-2, 3-0 Pac-12). His top outing was 240 yards - second-most in school history -- against then-No. 13 Texas Tech on Sept. 12. He has caught three touchdown passes twice and grabbed two on three other occasions. He has at least one touchdown catch in each game. His season high for receptions is 10 against San Diego State. He had 191 yards and three scores in the Beavers' 66-14 trouncing of the Aztecs. Legree is averaging 22.6 yards on 46 receptions. Legree has recently been mentioned as a Heisman Trophy candidate. He said he belongs at the top of the conversation. "Never seen a freshman do what I'm doing week in and week out, and I feel like I'm going to continue to do that," Legree said. "And I feel like everybody who doesn't feel like I should be in that conversation will notice by the end of the season that I deserve that, or should at least be in the top-three conversation." Oregon State is averaging 51 points per game during a five-game winning streak in JaMarcus Shepherd's first season as head coach. Legree also held the event during Oregon State's bye week to help attract media attention to the program in hopes of landing athletes for the program. Oregon State also has a quarterback on the rise in Mercer transfer Branden Atkinson, who won the Jerry Rice Award last season as the top freshman in the FCS. Atkinson leads the nation in passing yardage (2,604 yards) and touchdown passes (24) and has thrown just two interceptions for Oregon State. The Beavers return to action on Oct. 31 at Fresno State (4-3, 1-2). --Field Level Media

item.title: Caso de Ebola na Nigéria está ligado ao vírus encontrado no primeiro caso do Quênia, diz ministro da Saúde
item.description: Uma análise genômica do único caso confirmado de Ebola na Nigéria mostra que o vírus está estreitamente relacionado à cepa detectada no primeiro caso registrado no Quênia, disse nesta sexta-feira o ministro da Saúde nigeriano, Muhammad Ali Pate, fornecendo a primeira ligação genética entre os surtos.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
item.content:encoded: Uma análise genômica do único caso confirmado de Ebola na Nigéria mostra que o vírus está estreitamente relacionado à cepa detectada no primeiro caso registrado no Quênia, disse nesta sexta-feira o ministro da Saúde nigeriano, Muhammad Ali Pate, fornecendo a primeira ligação genética entre os surtos. Pate disse que os contatos ligados ao caso estão sendo rastreados, colocados em quarentena e testados, com alguns resultados negativos e outros ainda pendentes A Nigéria registrou apenas um caso confirmado de Ebola, de um viajante que havia visitado Uganda Uganda, que faz fronteira com a República Democrática do Congo (RDC) e já enfrentou surtos de Ebola anteriormente, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que continuava livre do Ebola, mas estava reforçando as precauções O Ministério da Saúde de Uganda informou que os formulários de localização de viajantes foram restabelecidos para todos os que chegam ao país, independentemente do país de origem Uganda informou que viajantes com histórico de viagem à RDC, onde o surto teve início, não terão permissão para transitar pelo país

item.title: Ronaldinho to return to action with Italian club Ravenna
item.description: Brazil great Ronaldinho will return to competitive football next month when he plays for Italian third-tier side Ravenna against local rivals Forli on November 15, the Serie C club announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil great Ronaldinho will return to competitive football next month when he plays for Italian third-tier side Ravenna against local rivals Forli on November 15, the Serie C club announced on Friday. The 46-year-old former Barcelona and AC Milan forward, who won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil and the Ballon d'Or in 2005, last played competitively for Brazilian club Fluminense in 2015. He officially retired in 2018. Ravenna signed Ronaldinho in June and he later acquired a stake in the club, which is owned by his friend Ignazio Cipriani. Cipriani said the move was intended "to bring the whole city closer to the team". [USN:L8N44H1KF TEXT:"Ronaldinho"] stopped short of confirming he would play when he arrived in Italy in August, although he left open the prospect of scoring the 300th goal of his career. "I'm here to help," he said at the time. The derby against Forli will take place at Ravenna's Stadio Bruno Benelli. Ravenna sit second in Serie C Group B with 20 points from 10 games, eight behind leaders Spezia.

item.title: Moody's maintient la note souveraine de la France à "Aa3"
item.description: L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1". "La notation Aa3 repose sur l'hypothèse qu'un budget réduisant le déficit sera adopté pour 2027, tandis que les coûts de financement et les tensions sociales s'atténueront quelque peu au cours des prochains mois", indique Moody's dans un communiqué. "Cette annonce déjoue les pronostics déclinistes de nombreux 'experts' et de ceux qui spéculent sur la dette française", a réagi le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu sur son compte X. "Le gouvernement a proposé au Parlement un budget sérieux avec une réduction du déficit permis par des efforts partagés", a poursuivi le Premier ministre, saluant l'action des forces politiques qui, sans majorité, ont accepté d'ouvrir le débat sur le budget dans un calendrier normal. "Ce signal montre à nos prêteurs qu'il existe un chemin. Il nous appartient de le poursuivre pour donner à la France un budget d'ici la fin de l'année, conforme à l'objectif de 5% de déficit", écrit encore Sébastien Lecornu. Le ministre de l'Economie, Roland Lescure, a dit pour sa part prendre acte de la décision de Moody's, qui devrait alléger la pression sur le gouvernement dans un contexte de finances mises à rude épreuve et de troubles sociaux. "Cette décision est la reconnaissance de la solidité de notre économie et de la crédibilité du budget présenté par le gouvernement dans le projet de loi de finances pour 2027, qui vise à poursuivre le rétablissement des comptes publics", a écrit Roland Lescure sur le réseau social Bluesky et dans un communiqué publié par le ministère français des Finances. Une dégradation par Moody's de la note de la France aurait aligné celle-ci sur les décisions prises en 2025 par [USN:L5N3VY1MP TEXT:"Standard & Poor's"] et [USN:L5N3UZ1HN TEXT:"Fitch"]. La France peine cependant à maîtriser ses finances publiques avec une situation qui s'est aggravée depuis que les élections législatives anticipées de 2024 ont abouti à un Parlement divisé en trois grands blocs, sans majorité, provoquant ainsi une quasi paralysie politique. Selon le projet de loi de finances, la France table sur un déficit budgétaire à 5,4% du produit intérieur brut (PIB) pour cette année et le gouvernement prévoit de ramener ce déficit à 5,0% en 2027. La dette publique, quant à elle, devrait atteindre 119,3% du PIB cette année et pourrait grimper à 121,7% en 2027, alors que ce ratio était de 115,7% en 2025. Une baisse à l'avenir de la note de la France pourrait réduire le nombre d'investisseurs capables ou disposés à détenir des obligations françaises ou à les accepter en garantie. Les coûts d'emprunt de la France dépassent déjà ceux de pays moins bien notés comme l'Italie, les investisseurs s'inquiétant du niveau du déficit budgétaire – l'un des plus importants de la zone euro – et à l'incertitude liée à l'approche de l'élection présidentielle, prévue les 18 avril et 2 mai. Les sondages laissent entrevoir une possible victoire de Marine Le Pen, candidate du parti d'extrême droite Rassemblement national (RN), contre Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader de La France Insoumise (LFI), perçu comme une formation d'extrême gauche.

item.title: Francia se libra de la rebaja de la calificación de Moody's mientras se enfrenta a los disturbios
item.description: Moody's evitó el viernes una rebaja de la calificación crediticia de Francia, lo que alivió la presión sobre un Gobierno que lucha por contener el malestar social y reforzar sus maltrechas finanzas.
item.dc:creator: Leigh Thomas, Dhara Ranasinghe
item.content:encoded: Moody's evitó el viernes una rebaja de la calificación crediticia de Francia, lo que alivió la presión sobre un Gobierno que lucha por contener el malestar social y reforzar sus maltrechas finanzas. Moody's afirmó que había concluido una revisión periódica de su calificación, manteniéndola en Aa3, con perspectiva negativa desde el pasado mes de octubre. Los mercados de bonos ya habían descontado una rebaja, lo que habría alineado a Moody's con Standard & Poor's y Fitch, que ya habían tomado medidas mientras Francia luchaba por controlar sus finanzas públicas tras unas elecciones anticipadas de 2024 que dieron lugar a un parlamento sin mayoría y a una parálisis política. El Ministerio de Hacienda francés señaló en un comunicado que el hecho de que Moody's mantuviera inalterada su calificación reflejaba la "credibilidad del presupuesto que el Gobierno ha presentado en el proyecto de ley de presupuestos para 2027, diseñado para mantener nuestras finanzas públicas en la senda de la recuperación". El Gobierno está teniendo dificultades para aprobar el proyecto de ley en el Parlamento, donde los partidos de la oposición podrían negarse a llegar a un acuerdo, rechazar la legislación y derrocarlo mediante un voto de censura. "La calificación Aa3 parte de la base de que se aprobará un presupuesto de reducción del déficit para 2027, mientras que los costos de financiación y las tensiones sociales remitirán en cierta medida en los próximos meses", señaló Moody's en un comunicado. Los costos de financiación de Francia ya superan a los de países con calificaciones más bajas, como Italia. Los inversionistas se muestran preocupados por el déficit presupuestario —uno de los mayores de la zona del euro— y por las elecciones presidenciales del 18 de abril y el 2 de mayo del próximo año, en las que las encuestas sugieren que la extrema derecha podría ganar. Las imágenes televisivas de las protestas del fin de semana, que degeneraron en disturbios y saqueos, ponen de relieve la dificultad política que supone sacar adelante los recortes presupuestarios. Esto contribuyó a que, el jueves, la prima de riesgo de la deuda pública francesa frente a los bonos alemanes —considerados un valor refugio— alcanzara su nivel más alto en 15 años, mientras que el rendimiento del bono de referencia francés a 10 años se situó en el 5,14%, su nivel más alto desde julio de 2002. Moody's afirmó a principios de este mes que la capacidad del Gobierno francés para superar la "fragmentación en el Parlamento" sería el factor clave para su próxima decisión sobre la calificación. Esa tarea parece más difícil después de que las violentas protestas por la falta de financiación de las escuelas se intensificaran el fin de semana hasta convertirse en disturbios durante las manifestaciones masivas contra el costo de la vida. El Gobierno se ha negado a destinar más fondos a la educación o a aumentar el salario mínimo, y están previstas nuevas protestas el sábado. En el Parlamento, la Cámara Baja ha rechazado algunas medidas de ahorro clave del presupuesto para 2027, que prevé un déficit del 5% del PIB frente al 5,4% de este año.

item.title: Judge approves defunct talc supplier's $535 million settlement with Berkshire affiliate
item.description: A US bankruptcy judge has approved a $535 million settlement between a defunct talc supplier and Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance unit, overruling objections that the deal would provide too little money to resolve lawsuits alleging the company’s talc contained asbestos and caused cancer.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: A US bankruptcy judge has approved a $535 million settlement between a defunct talc supplier and Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance unit, overruling objections that the deal would provide too little money to resolve lawsuits alleging the company’s talc contained asbestos and caused cancer. US bankruptcy judge Michael Kaplan in New Jersey on Thursday ruled that Whittaker Clark & Daniels' settlement was fair and reasonable, based on his evaluation of the talc litigation claims and the claimants' ability to win judgments against the company's former corporate parents. The settlement aims to resolve liabilities of Berkshire's National Indemnity Co., which purchased Whittaker Clark & Daniels and assumed its liabilities in 2007, and other former corporate affiliates like chemical distributor Brenntag. Whittaker filed for bankruptcy in 2023, citing a “deluge” of lawsuits from roughly 2,700 people who alleged the company supplied asbestos-contaminated talc to makers of cosmetics, chemicals and other products, causing cancer. Talc claimants argued that the settlement was an insider deal between the defunct Whittaker and its corporate owners and affiliates, which resolved those companies' liabilities without any input from talc claimants. The deal was designed to shield well-heeled companies that could be liable for billions of dollars in talc claims, like National Indemnity Co., Berkshire Hathaway, former corporate affiliate Brenntag, and others with a shared corporate history, according to talc claimants. The talc claimants had asked the court for permission to sue Brenntag, National Indemnity Co., and other potential corporate successors for a higher contribution, but Kaplan denied that request. Kaplan ruled that Whittaker was responsible for suing those companies for indemnification and contribution to the bankruptcy, and that other plaintiffs could not usurp legal claims that were property of the debtor. Suzanne Ratcliffe, an attorney who represents asbestos claimants in the bankruptcy, said that the ruling was "wrong" and that she planned to appeal. "This order blesses a greed-fueled insider 'settlement' between Whittaker and multi-billionaires — including Berkshire Hathaway affiliates — a settlement which no victim wants or asked for,” Ratcliffe said in a statement. The talc claimants have filed a petition with the US Supreme Court to challenge an earlier ruling in the case, saying that debtors should not be able to use bankruptcy to block plaintiffs who want to sue a bankrupt company's non-bankrupt owners. The Supreme Court has not acted on that petition. Whittaker operated one of the largest talc and industrial compound supply and distribution businesses in the US in the 1970s and 1980s, but it ceased operations in 2004. Its corporate existence since then has largely been devoted to resolving a growing wave of legal claims related to its decades-long production of talc and industrial chemicals. Brenntag acquired Whittaker's operating assets in 2004, while leaving the asbestos liabilities with Whittaker. National Indemnity Co. later bought Whittaker and assumed its remaining assets and liabilities. Brenntag has denied being responsible for the defunct company's talc liabilities. The case is Whittaker Clark & Daniels Inc. et al., US Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, 23-1357 For Whittaker Clark & Daniels: Chad Husnick and Joshua Sussberg of Kirkland & Ellis LLP, Michael Sirota and Felice Yudkin of Cole Schotz P.C., among others. For the official committee of talc claimants: Arthur Abramowitz of Sherman Silverstein, among others For talc claimant Juliet Gray: Suzanne Ratcliffe and Clay Thompson of Maune Raichle Hartley French

item.title: Fiscal general Costa Rica dice nuevas operaciones conjuntas con la DEA se enfocarán en políticos y empresarios
item.description: Costa Rica intensificará su cooperación con la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA) de Estados Unidos para perseguir delincuentes que el fiscal general del país, recientemente reelecto, denomina "narcotraficantes invisibles", incluyendo empresarios y políticos que ocultan sus presuntos vínculos con el tráfico de drogas tras una imagen pública respetable.
item.dc:creator: Alvaro Murillo
item.content:encoded: Costa Rica intensificará su cooperación con la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA) de Estados Unidos para perseguir delincuentes que el fiscal general del país, recientemente reelecto, denomina "narcotraficantes invisibles", incluyendo empresarios y políticos que ocultan sus presuntos vínculos con el tráfico de drogas tras una imagen pública respetable. El fiscal general Carlo Díaz, que se ha enfrentado en repetidas ocasiones al Gobierno de la presidenta Laura Fernández, fue reelecto el lunes por el Poder Judicial para un nuevo mandato de cuatro años. En una entrevista concedida a Reuters el jueves, afirmó que los investigadores no mostrarían clemencia alguna si los implicados ocupaban puestos de alto nivel. “Esta segunda etapa va enfocada a objetivos que hemos denominado ‘narcotraficantes invisibles’, declaró Díaz, tras una fase inicial de misiones conjuntas dirigidas contra miembros de organizaciones criminales. “Son personas empresarias, a veces profesionales, a veces políticos, que son exitosos en la sociedad o personas muy visibles. Sin embargo, detrás de esa fachada está la vinculación directa con ese tipo de actividades”, añadió. Díaz también elogió la capacidad de Costa Rica para extraditar a sus propios ciudadanos a Estados Unidos como un hito en la lucha contra la delincuencia transnacional y señaló que se había extraditado a seis personas y que había otros 25 procedimientos de extradición en curso. La oficina de la DEA no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El Gobierno de Costa Rica ya ha colaborado anteriormente con la DEA para detener a decenas de narcotraficantes, a quienes las autoridades costarricenses consideran responsables del aumento de las tasas de homicidios en los últimos años en esta nación centroamericana, que durante mucho tiempo había gozado de paz. Las autoridades estadounidenses han señalado que Costa Rica actúa como un corredor clave para el traslado de narcóticos desde Sudamérica hacia Estados Unidos. Fernández, una aliada conservadora del presidente Donald Trump, ha alineado estrechamente a Costa Rica con Washington en materia de seguridad, sumándose a la iniciativa[USN:L6N45E101 TEXT:" "Escudo de las Américas""] del presidente estadounidense contra el narcotráfico y el crimen organizado. DIVISIONES POLÍTICAS Díaz afirmó que los responsables de la DEA le habían expresado directamente su preocupación por las divisiones políticas e institucionales en Costa Rica, que, según él, están obstaculizando la lucha contra el crimen organizado. Se ha enfrentado en repetidas ocasiones con Fernández y con su predecesor, Rodrigo Chaves, acusando al Gobierno de intentar debilitar al poder judicial. A pesar de respaldar una cooperación más estrecha con la DEA, Díaz rechazó la sugerencia de Fernández del mes pasado de que Costa Rica podría beneficiarse de la presencia de [USN:L6N44W128 TEXT:"fuerzas estadounidenses"] operando en su territorio. “Si nos enfocamos en dar los recursos que necesita la Fuerza Pública, esta podría tomar el control territorial sin necesidad de traer fuerzas armadas de otros países”, afirmó. El gobierno de Fernández ha construido una prisión con capacidad para 5.100 reclusos siguiendo el modelo de la campaña de seguridad de El Salvador, un enfoque que Díaz ha cuestionado en el marco de sus enfrentamientos con el Gobierno. Afirmó que la prisión podría aliviar el hacinamiento, pero que por sí sola no frenaría el crimen organizado y subrayó que el panorama delictivo de Costa Rica difiere notablemente de el de El Salvador. La tasa de homicidios en Costa Rica, considerada durante mucho tiempo uno de los países más seguros de la región, alcanzó su máximo en 2023 con 17,2 por cada 100.000 habitantes, lo que supone 906 asesinatos, con una ligera disminución en 2024 y 2025. "Este es uno de los momentos más complejos de nuestra historia", afirmó Díaz. "(La DEA) está muy consciente de la situación".

item.title: Morocco expects stable fiscal deficit despite tax cuts in 2027
item.description: Morocco expects a steady fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP despite higher spending on social programmes and tax cuts, newly appointed finance and economy minister Fouzi Lekjaa said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
item.content:encoded: Morocco expects a steady fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP despite higher spending on social programmes and tax cuts, newly appointed finance and economy minister Fouzi Lekjaa said on Friday. The economy is expected to grow 3.7% in 2027, down from a forecast of 4.7% this year, assuming an average crop year, Lekjaa told members of parliament while presenting the 2027 draft budget. Morocco announced a [USN:S8N3UN004 TEXT:"new government coalition"] last week following [USN:S8N3SV012 TEXT:"September 23 elections"], placing priority on purchasing power, social services and youth employment, one year after [USN:L2N3VI14N TEXT:"GenZ protests"] and the [USN:L6N4410N7 TEXT:"Ceuta migration crisis"] in July. The government's social policies in previous years have been weakened by an [USN:L6N3VN095 TEXT:"economic model"] that prioritised market forces over regulation, fostering monopolistic practices, rent-seeking and quick profits, Lekjaa said. "Savage capitalism and neo-liberalism" have been at the heart of social tension, he said, urging a stronger role for the state in combating corruption, conflicts of interest and monopolies, while safeguarding food and energy sovereignty. In total, the government plans to spend 62 billion dirhams ($6.3 billion) next year on measures aimed at improving social services, boosting purchasing power and reducing inequalities, Lekjaa said. The measures include reforming distribution channels for basic goods, promoting youth employment and exempting salaries of less than 10,000 dirhams a month, which would account for 87% of all employees, from income tax, he said. The package also includes pension increases, higher financial aid for needy families and electricity subsidies. The health budget would rise 7% to 45.5 billion dirhams, while education spending would increase 4.6% to 121 billion dirhams, according to the draft budget. The draft also authorises defence expenditure commitments of up to 190.5 billion dirhams. Public debt is forecast to decline to 66.9% of GDP in 2027 from 67.5% this year, the budget document showed. The government proposes raising to 40% the tax rate on profits above 100 million dirhams earned by fuel distribution companies, a sector previously sanctioned by competition authorities for anti-competitive practices. The draft budget increases excise taxes on soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, cigarettes and e-cigarettes. The government's financing requirement is expected to fall 7.4% to 159 billion dirhams in 2027 as it seeks to balance domestic and external borrowing "depending on market conditions," according to the draft budget.

item.title: BC aprova medidas para ampliar proteção de consumidor financeiro nas relações de crédito
item.description: O Banco Central aprovou três resoluções sobre as responsabilidades de instituições financeiras na oferta e concessão de crédito, com novas salvaguardas contra ofertas inadequadas ou abusivas e maior transparência antes da contratação, segundo nota divulgada nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Banco Central aprovou três resoluções sobre as responsabilidades de instituições financeiras na oferta e concessão de crédito, com novas salvaguardas contra ofertas inadequadas ou abusivas e maior transparência antes da contratação, segundo nota divulgada nesta sexta-feira. A primeira delas estabelece que as instituições deverão oferecer mecanismo claro para o bloqueio de propagandas e ofertas ativas. A segunda diz que as empresas deverão oferecer aos clientes o Painel de Dívidas Consolidadas, "que reunirá informações sobre suas operações de crédito e ampliará a transparência sobre o nível de endividamento e o comprometimento da capacidade de pagamento". Além disso, as instituições deverão disponibilizar informações e ferramentas como simulador de crédito e ambiente para consulta das operações contratadas. O BC estabeleceu ainda novas regras para a oferta de crédito durante a iniciação de transações Pix, "com maior proteção e transparência para os usuários". As novas normas entram em vigor entre março e julho de 2027, disse o Banco Central.

item.title: Reigning champion Picklum takes first win of the season in Portugal tubefest
item.description: Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum won the Portugal Pro in thumping tubes on Friday, claiming her first victory of the year and jumping to the top of the rankings with just two events of surfing's world tour remaining.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum won the Portugal Pro in thumping tubes on Friday, claiming her first victory of the year and jumping to the top of the rankings with just two events of surfing's world tour remaining. California's Griffin Colapinto scored a near-perfect barrel to come from behind and claim the win over Brazil's Gabriel Medina in the men's final, notching up his third victory at the powerful Portuguese beach break of Supertubos. Picklum has had a strong if not spectacular season after winning her first [USN:L4N3UI1HG TEXT:"world title in Fiji"] last year, but had made only one final and set her sights on securing a win in Portugal ahead of the season finale in Hawaii in December. "It was a dream of mine to win here," the 23-year-old said. "Portugal is like the cross between the Brazilian energy and Pipeline. Those are two of my favourite things. "I’m really happy to hit my stride at the right time. We work so hard and not many people get to win, but I’m so stoked to get my win this year.” Up against California's 2024 world champion Caitlin Simmers in the final, Picklum slipped behind in the early exchanges before locking into a deep, overhead tube on her backhand that scored 7.83 out of 10 and gave her the lead. Simmers threaded some nice tubes of her own but ended with a two-wave total of 12.84 to Picklum's 13.33. Colapinto, 28, has developed a special relationship with the powerful, punchy tubes around the seaside town of Peniche, securing event wins in 2022, 2024 and now 2026. He started strongly in the final, hustling Medina for the first wave, pulling into a deep barrel on his forehand and finishing it strongly. He scored an excellent 8.17 and backed it up quickly with a similar wave to pile the pressure on Medina. But Brazil's three-time world champion responded with an incredible barrel of his own on his backhand, squeezing out when all hope seemed lost, then took the lead with another long tube. Needing something special, Colapinto found a gem on his backhand, disappearing behind the curtain for the entire wave and emerging near the packed crowd on the beach for a 9.43 out of a possible 10 and a lead he held until the clock ran out. “That’s the dream. How good were the waves out there?” said Colapinto, who climbed to third in the rankings after his win. “The battle with Gabriel was unreal ... Portugal has a big place in my heart." The tour heads next to a new stop in the Philippines before the last event of the year at Pipeline, where 1.5 times points will be on offer.

item.title: USDA corrige los datos sobre el maíz de septiembre debido a un "error de procesamiento"
item.description: El Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU (USDA) informó el viernes que ha corregido los datos sobre el maíz que publicó en septiembre después de que un "error de procesamiento" afectara a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción del país.
item.dc:creator: Tom Polansek
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU (USDA) informó el viernes que ha corregido los datos sobre el maíz que publicó en septiembre después de que un "error de procesamiento" afectara a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción del país. El USDA se ha visto sometido al escrutinio de los comerciantes de cereales, analistas y economistas en cuanto a la fiabilidad de sus estimaciones de cosechas debido a una serie de errores en los datos. La agencia, considerada desde hace tiempo como la referencia por excelencia en materia de información sobre el mercado agrícola mundial, había afirmado anteriormente que estaba tratando de mejorar las estimaciones de cosechas. El Servicio Nacional de Estadísticas Agrícolas (NASS) del USDA descubrió el error tras surgir inquietudes sobre un informe de cosechas de este mes que preveía que los agricultores estadounidenses cosecharían más bushels de maíz de lo esperado inicialmente, según el comunicado. La previsión de cosecha, superior a lo esperado, provocó una caída de los futuros del maíz estadounidense. "El NASS detectó un error de procesamiento que afectó a las densidades de siembra de maíz de septiembre, al recuento de mazorcas, a los rendimientos y a la producción en Kansas y Nebraska", sostuvo el comunicado. "El error también afectó a los promedios de 10 estados correspondientes a septiembre en cuanto a densidades de plantación y recuento de mazorcas, así como a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción de maíz en EEUU". Un informe corregido que el USDA publicó en su página web mostraba un rendimiento del maíz en septiembre de 178,8 bushels por acre. El mes pasado, el USDA indicó que su estimación del rendimiento para septiembre era de 178,5 bushels por acre. El USDA revisó su estimación de producción de septiembre a 15.828 millones de bushels, frente a la estimación original de septiembre de 15.800 millones. Las previsiones de cosechas para octubre se revisaron, se validaron y no han variado, informó el USDA.

item.title: PHP Foundation 'under-funded' with one full-time staff member, director says
item.description: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites safe from hackers, showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet.
item.dc:creator: Toby Sterling
item.content:encoded: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites [USN:L1N468095 TEXT:"safe from hackers, "]showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet. Yet the nonprofit foundation that supports PHP, which may underpin up to 70% of sites globally, operates on a shoestring budget. “We have one full-time staff member (that's me) and 14 mostly part-time contractors,” Executive Director Elizabeth Barron of the PHP Foundation said via email in an interview on Friday. Board members are unpaid volunteers, and funding comes from donations and grants. The foundation works with outside researchers and companies, including OpenAI and cybersecurity firms Wiz and Calif, to investigate security flaws and coordinate fixes, including Wednesday's patches. While Web security company Cloudflare has reported millions of hacking attempts, Barron said the foundation had no evidence hackers were able to exploit the vulnerabilities before they were disclosed, or on sites that have been patched. "We received no further indication from OpenAI, Wiz or Calif, with whom we're working closely on this issue, regarding any issues on patched systems,” she said. Artificial intelligence has proved both a help and a burden to the foundation. It helped researchers find the flaws, which had been present for a decade, and Barron said it made programmers more efficient. However, it is also increasing maintainers' workloads. The PHP project is receiving nearly twice as many proposed code changes as a year ago, “yet the number of contributors hasn't doubled,” she said. Reviewing contributions and bug reports requires “a massive amount of human input and experience.” Recent events have shown how heavily companies and governments rely on PHP, Barron said. “Given that reliance, it is clear that PHP is incredibly under-funded.”

item.title: Líder norcoreano Kim aboga por una "revolución militar", pide que se refuercen las unidades del ejército
item.description: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un instó a que las compañías del ejército del país se conviertan en unidades de combate de élite y autosuficientes durante una reunión de dos días de los comandantes de compañía celebrada en Pyongyang, informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un instó a que las compañías del ejército del país se conviertan en unidades de combate de élite y autosuficientes durante una reunión de dos días de los comandantes de compañía celebrada en Pyongyang, informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA. El evento puso de relieve la prioridad política constante de Kim de fortalecer el ejército. En un discurso en una conferencia de comandantes de compañía del Ejército el 22 y 23 de octubre —que, según KCNA, fue la primera de todo el ejército desde el IX Congreso del partido gobernante de Corea del Norte celebrado en febrero—, Kim instó a todas las compañías a prepararse a fondo para que se pueda alcanzar "el objetivo del refuerzo militar de la nueva era". "Construyamos el ejército más fuerte y aceleremos una revolución militar a nuestra manera", afirmó Kim. Durante el IX Congreso del partido gobernante de Corea del Norte de febrero, en el que se estableció la dirección del país para los próximos cinco años, Kim abogó por unas fuerzas armadas convencionales más fuertes, al tiempo que reafirmó los esfuerzos para desarrollar armas nucleares y misiles.

item.title: Alguns parisienses compram spray de pimenta e gás lacrimogêneo, alegando legítima defesa antes de protestos
item.description: Os parisienses estão comprando cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo e sprays de pimenta para se defenderem e protegerem seus bens durante os protestos, que devem continuar ao longo do fim de semana, disse à Reuters o proprietário de uma loja de armas na capital francesa.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Howcroft, Ardee Napolitano
item.content:encoded: Os parisienses estão comprando cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo e sprays de pimenta para se defenderem e protegerem seus bens durante os protestos, que devem continuar ao longo do fim de semana, disse à Reuters o proprietário de uma loja de armas na capital francesa. A França foi atingida pelo pior levante social dos últimos anos no último fim de semana, quando protestos em todo o país contra os altos preços e a deterioração dos serviços públicos se transformaram em tumultos. Uma prefeitura foi incendiada, lojas foram saqueadas e prédios cobertos de pichações, enquanto grupos violentos entraram em confronto com a polícia em cidades por todo o país. A polícia autorizou apenas uma manifestação sindical em Paris no sábado, rejeitando os pedidos de manifestações apresentados pela principal união estudantil da França, a Unef, e pelo movimento antissistema dos Coletes Amarelos. Na loja de armas Armurerie de la Bourse, no centro de Paris, o proprietário Yves Gollety disse à Reuters que observou um grande aumento nas vendas de armas não letais desde o fim de semana. Lojas a apenas 30 metros de distância foram saqueadas, com suas persianas arrancadas, disse ele. “É a primeira vez que vemos um aumento desse tipo, e em todos os segmentos da população”, disse Gollety, acrescentando que entre seus clientes estão lojistas, donos de restaurantes e pessoas físicas. “As pessoas ficaram traumatizadas fisicamente e estão com medo”, disse ele. Os produtos mais vendidos são sprays de pimenta e cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo, que, segundo Gollety, só podem ser usados em legítima defesa. Gollety, que também é presidente da associação nacional de armeiros, disse ao jornal francês Le Parisien que os pedidos aumentaram dez vezes. O público em geral só tem permissão para comprar pequenos recipientes com menos de 100 mililitros, disse Gollety. A Reuters não encontrou evidências de que as pessoas em Paris estivessem comprando outros tipos de armas em resposta aos protestos. Alain Di Crescenzo, presidente da Câmara de Comércio da França, pediu aos lojistas que se abstivessem de usar armas para defender seus negócios. Em entrevista à emissora de rádio Europe 1 nesta sexta-feira, ele disse ter visto pessoalmente lojistas se armando com tacos de beisebol, pés-de-cabra e espingardas. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar essa informação de forma independente. “É extremamente preocupante”, disse ele. “Não é função deles fazer isso... Isso só aumentaria o sofrimento.” “A polícia deve ter liberdade para fazer seu trabalho, e recomendo a máxima cautela”, acrescentou. “É PRECISO ESTAR PREPARADO” Um lojista que vende motos e scooters no 15º arrondissement de Paris disse à Reuters que comprou três grandes cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo, além de outro menor, para proteger sua loja. “Você pode ser pego de surpresa, com pessoas chegando sem qualquer aviso prévio. Por isso, é preciso estar preparado”, disse o lojista, que pediu para não ser identificado. O governo francês prometeu reforçar a segurança e mobilizará 70 mil policiais, apoiados por unidades especializadas, para os protestos de sábado, mas o aumento no número de pessoas pensando em como se defender ilustra os temores dos parisienses à medida que o fim de semana se aproxima. Um homem que visitava a loja de Gollety, um funcionário do setor financeiro de 58 anos que não quis se identificar, disse que havia pesquisado opções de autodefesa, embora, no fim das contas, não tivesse comprado nada nessa ocasião. “Considerando o que aconteceu na semana passada e o risco de isso se repetir no próximo fim de semana, prefiro ser sensato e me proteger”, disse ele, acrescentando que há muito tempo tem uma sensação de insegurança. “Venho pensando nisso há muito tempo e acho que vou tomar algumas medidas”, disse ele. Em outra parte de Paris, Yvan Weiss, dono de uma empresa de consultoria financeira, disse à Reuters que estava tomando medidas para evitar que as vitrines de sua empresa fossem quebradas. Questionado se considerava adquirir spray de pimenta ou outro equipamento de defesa, ele disse que havia pensado nisso, mas que, no fim, decidiu instalar persianas metálicas automáticas na fachada de sua loja.

item.title: Allegiant exercises options for six Boeing 737 MAX jets worth over $720 million
item.description: Allegiant Air said on Friday it had exercised options to buy six Boeing 737-8 aircraft under a 2021 purchase agreement with the planemaker.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Allegiant Air (ALGT.O) said on Friday it had exercised options to buy six Boeing (BA.N) 737-8 aircraft under a 2021 purchase agreement with the planemaker. The jets, scheduled for delivery in 2028, have a combined list price of more than $720 million, the company said. Allegiant has 56 firm aircraft under the agreement, including 22 already delivered, while purchase options remain for another 74 jets. Based on delivery year, the estimated market value of the planes is about $351 million, according to aviation analytics consultancy firm IBA.

item.title: North Korea's Kim calls for 'military revolution' as he urges stronger army units
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for the country's army companies to be turned into elite, self-sufficient combat units during a two-day meeting of company commanders in Pyongyang, state media KCNA said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for the country's army companies to be turned into elite, self-sufficient combat units during a two-day meeting of company commanders in Pyongyang, state media KCNA said on Saturday. The event underscored Kim's consistent policy priority of strengthening the military. In a speech at a conference of company commanders for North Korea's Army on October 22-23, which KCNA said was the first military-wide gathering since the Ninth Congress of North Korea's ruling party in February, Kim called for every company to fully prepare so that "the goal of the new-era military build-up" can be achieved. "Let us build the strongest army and speed up a military revolution in our style", Kim said. During the [USN:L1N3ZL1I9 TEXT:"Ninth Congress"] of North Korea's ruling party in February, which sets the country's direction for the next five years, Kim called for stronger conventional armed forces as well as reaffirming efforts to develop nuclear weapons and missiles.

item.title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes in US a national security threat
item.description: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday. Washington has long accused Confucius Institutes of being Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them. Hegseth, in a video posted on social media, alleged that Confucius Institutes were operating under disguise at US universities and that the Pentagon had added them to its list of institutions that threaten US national security. "It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students," Hegseth said. The Defense Department over the past two months has "systematically dismantled every single one of these organizations," he said. The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
item.description: Genomic analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering the first genetic link between the outbreaks.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
item.content:encoded: Genomic analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering the first genetic link between the outbreaks. Nigerian authorities said there is no evidence that the Kenya index case traveled to Nigeria or had a direct connection to the Nigerian case. Pate said contacts linked to the case are being traced, quarantined and tested, with some results negative and others still pending Nigeria has recorded only one confirmed Ebola case from a traveller who had visited Uganda Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and has previously battled Ebola outbreaks, said on Friday it remained Ebola-free but was tightening precautions Uganda's health ministry said traveller locator forms had been reinstated for all arrivals, regardless of country of origin Uganda said travellers with a history of travel to the DRC, where the outbreak began, will not be permitted to transit the country

item.title: Colombia canjea deuda interna por 3.234 millones de dólares
item.description: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que realizó un canje de títulos de deuda pública interna por 10,3 billones de pesos (3.234 millones de dólares), para extender los vencimientos y reducir la presión de pagos a corto plazo ante las dificultades fiscales del país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que realizó un canje de títulos de deuda pública interna por 10,3 billones de pesos (3.234 millones de dólares), para extender los vencimientos y reducir la presión de pagos a corto plazo ante las dificultades fiscales del país. En la operación, el Gobierno recogió títulos de deuda pública interna TES con vencimiento entre noviembre de 2026 y noviembre de 2027, y a cambio entregó papeles con plazos entre 2029 y 2062, precisó el Ministerio en un comunicado. Se trata del segundo de tres canjes de deuda pública local que el Gobierno planea realizar antes de finalizar el año. En el anterior canje, realizado a inicios de octubre, el Gobierno intercambió títulos por 19,8 billones de pesos (6.217 millones de dólares). Los TES son la segunda fuente de financiación interna del gasto público, después del recaudo de impuestos. Según el Ministerio de Hacienda, el tercer canje se realizará el 19 de noviembre. "Con esta operación el Gobierno Nacional alcanza un monto total canjeado de 30,1 billones de pesos, lo que representa una disminución del 50% en los vencimientos de 2026 y de 19% para los vencimientos en 2027, logrando una reducción de amortizaciones de 3,9 billones de pesos este año y de 26,2 billones el próximo", explicó el Ministerio de Hacienda. El Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella anunció en agosto cambios en el presupuesto de gastos de 2026, que establecen un endeudamiento adicional de 35 billones de pesos (10.989 millones de dólares) este año, para cubrir el pronóstico del déficit fiscal, que aumentó a un 7,2% del PIB desde una meta previa de 5,3%. (1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos)

item.title: In Florida, Trump vows to deal with Cuba after Iran gets settled
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Maria Cardona, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled. In a 90-minute speech in Fort Myers, Trump repeated more military action against Iran may lie ahead as he tries to address the causes of a spike in oil prices that has put Republicans on the defensive ahead of the November 3 midterm elections . With an eye toward the senior Americans who live in Florida, Trump said he planned to spend $250 million to hire at least 5,000 new nurses in elder care facilities all across America. While the Iran war has no end in sight, Trump talked tough about Cuba, part of a pattern of putting pressure on the communist government there after ousting the leader of Venezuela early this year. Trump, who won 68% of the Cuban American vote in Florida in the 2024 election, said American naval forces from Iran will stop at Cuba on the way home. "We'll have one of them stop about 50 yards off the coast. They'll raise up their hands, and then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," he said. Secretary of State Rubio, a former US senator from Florida, has been handling much of the Cuba-related policy for Trump. "To those who seek to create positive change in Cuba - now is the time," Rubio said on X on Friday, urging those disappointed by Cuba's government "to create the change you desire through a discrete partnership with the CIA." His post did not elaborate. Trump's rally was intended to boost the electoral prospects of Florida Republican Representative Byron Donalds, who is running for governor against Democrat David Jolly. His speech, the latest in a near-daily blitz of campaign rallies in largely friendly areas, rambled from topic to topic such as the size of his crowds and his White House renovations. Trump has increased pressure on Cuba in his second term. In September, he labeled Cuba a "failed state" at the UN General Assembly and said, "Freedom will be coming to Cuba," prompting a walkout by the Cuban delegation. Trump has openly stated that his goal is to fundamentally change Cuba's government. A US-imposed oil blockade has put the country under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and blackouts exacerbated by failing infrastructure. UN human rights experts have condemned the oil blockade as a violation of international law while rights advocates say the Trump administration's threats have echoed an [USN:L4N3YE036 TEXT:"imperialist approach"].

item.title: Russia, Ukraine agree on ceasefire in embattled town, to hold peace talks next month
item.description: Ukraine and Russia said on Friday they had agreed on a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, brokered through US first lady Melania Trump, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said peace negotiators would meet next month for new talks.
item.dc:creator: Steve Holland, Yuliia Dysa
item.content:encoded: Ukraine and Russia said on Friday they had agreed on a [USN:L1N4690MZ TEXT:"ceasefire"] in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, brokered through US first lady Melania Trump, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said [USN:L1N4690TJ TEXT:"peace negotiators"] would meet next month for new talks. The two sides said the ceasefire would go into effect on October 27, allowing the delivery of aid and the evacuation of residents through humanitarian corridors. Amid a US push to organise new talks aimed at ending the 4-1/2-year-old war , Zelenskiy said negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States had agreed to technical-level meetings in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi. A US official later said the three countries may hold their next talks in a couple weeks in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland. Zelenskiy said he hoped a meeting of the countries' leaders would follow. Previous rounds of talks headed by the United States stalled in February with no significant progress towards ending the bloodiest conflict in Europe since World War Two. Russia continues to demand Ukraine cede all of the eastern Donbas region, including territory Russia has not occupied militarily, while Kyiv rejects any notion of giving up land it currently holds. The latest peace efforts follow a rift between Washington and Kyiv in recent weeks and a series of moves by US President Donald Trump seen as favouring Russia. A major source of friction was limitations placed on SpaceX's Starlink communication system that Ukraine uses to protect against incoming attacks. Trump [USN:L6N4690ZQ TEXT:"said on Friday"] that if Ukraine still faced a problem with the system, he would straighten it out and, if necessary, speak about the matter to SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk. Another contentious point was Trump's announcement of a deal to allow Russia to provide diesel for the US and global markets, an agreement denounced by Ukraine and meant to keep prices down as the president's Republicans contest US midterm elections. On Friday, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak [USN:L1N469146 TEXT:"said"] the first three tankers with Russian diesel were on their way to North America. In the town of Oleshky, occupied by Russian forces since February 2022, residents have reported that they faced a deepening food crisis. "Both nations agreed to temporarily stop all military action in Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway," the White House said in a statement. The chief of staff of Russian forces, Valery Gerasimov, said on the Defence Ministry's Telegram channel that Russian troops would halt fire from 4 a.m. local time (0100 GMT) on October 27 to allow for the humanitarian operation to start. Ukraine's General Staff issued a statement agreeing to observe the ceasefire from the same time and pledging to "do everything possible to help Oleshky's residents." Ukraine says it has already [USN:L1N45Q03T TEXT:"used drones twice"] to send food into the town. Ukraine's human rights ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, also [USN:S8N4390AW TEXT:"said"] the ceasefire would go into effect on October 27 and told Reuters the operation [USN:S8N4390AW TEXT:"would involve"] demining roads to the town, deliveries of food and evacuations of civilians. MELANIA TRUMP'S DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS Both sides said Melania Trump played an important role in coordinating the agreement. The first lady has been active in trying to get Ukrainian children seized by Russia during the war returned to their families. "Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster," she said in a statement. "Oleshky's remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food and clean water." Pope Leo [USN:L8N4651KU TEXT:"had spoken"] in the past week both to Zelenskiy and to Russian President Vladimir Putin about conditions in Oleshky. The White House said Oleshky, located across the Dnipro River from the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, had 1,700 to 2,000 residents remaining, down from 24,000 before the war. US ENVOYS Zelenskiy's comments on resuming peace talks followed a meeting with US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff in Norway early this week and a subsequent meeting between Witkoff and Putin in St Petersburg. Zelenskiy said he spoke on Friday with Witkoff and US envoy Jared Kushner. He said any peace agreement would need strong security guarantees for Ukraine and funding for 10 years to maintain the Ukrainian army. "The plan is to meet in the first half of November, and as early as possible, of course," Zelenskiy told the Hudson Institute think tank via a video link. He said much would depend on Russia, noting that a similar meeting expected this month had not materialised. Zelenskiy spoke of the importance of continued diplomatic efforts to reach a ceasefire and end the war, now in its fifth year, adding that Europe should also be involved in the talks. Ukrainian officials said on Friday that speed restrictions on Starlink systems in Ukraine remained in place, despite Trump's previous statement that the services had been fully restored. Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday that he had not spoken to Musk about the restrictions but would do so if required. "If there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out," he said. The caps have been in place since October 13. Ukraine and Russia also swapped 270 servicemen each in a prisoner exchange on Friday, the Russian Defence Ministry said. Zelenskiy described the swap, the first since August, as a "very important result." Ukraine's acting prosecutor, Anton Kovalskyi, writing on Telegram, said more than 19,000 [USN:S8N44Z032 TEXT:"Ukrainian civilians"], including 762 children, had been killed since Russia launched its full-scale war more than four years ago.

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street finit dans le rouge une semaine mouvementée autour de l'IA
item.description: La Bourse de New York a fini en baisse vendredi, au terme d'une semaine mouvementée pour le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) alors que les investisseurs ont désormais les yeux rivés sur de nouveaux résultats d'entreprises et la décision prochaine de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a fini en baisse vendredi, au terme d'une semaine mouvementée pour le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) alors que les investisseurs ont désormais les yeux rivés sur de nouveaux résultats d'entreprises et la décision prochaine de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed). L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a cédé 652,82 points, soit 1,23%, à 52.215,16. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 39,75 points, soit 0,51%, à 7.623,68. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) , riche en valeurs technologiques, a reculé de 53,51 points, soit 0,20%, à 25.955,34, affichant ainsi une certaine stabilité au lendemain de sa plus forte baisse quotidienne enregistrée depuis juin. Le Nasdaq a pâti cette semaine des inquiétudes concernant les coûts de financement nécessaires pour soutenir les dépenses d'investissement massives dans l'IA. La plupart des secteurs du S&P 500 ont terminé la séance dans le rouge, les biens de consommation courante et les groupes financiers accusant les plus fortes baisses. A contrario, l'indice Philadelphia Semiconductor (.SOX) a rebondi de 0,44%, au lendemain d'un important repli. Le secteur technologique sur le S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) a, lui, progressé de 0,35%. Sur l'ensemble de la semaine, le S&P 500 et le Nasdaq ont reflué respectivement de 0,47% et 0,71%, tandis que l'indice Dow Jones a grappillé 0,41%, soutenu notamment par les valeurs défensives. La semaine prochaine, environ un tiers des entreprises du S&P 500 publieront leurs résultats trimestriels, notamment Alphabet (GOOGL.O) (-1,23%), Microsoft (MSFT.O) (+0,65%) et Amazon (AMZN.O) (-0,95%), trois géants de l'IA dont les prévisions de dépenses d'investissement seront suivies de près à Wall Street. "Les remous liés aux interrogations sur le secteur de l'IA se font encore sentir", a souligné Kristina Hooper, cheffe stratège marchés chez Man Group. "Il est tout à fait possible que les investissements dans la construction de centres de données dédiés à l'IA soient l'année prochaine inférieurs aux prévisions. Je pense donc que cela donne matière à réflexion", a-t-elle dit. LE SECTEUR TÉLÉCOMS BOUSCULÉ PAR SPACEX Aux valeurs, les groupes télécoms ont reculé après une information selon laquelle SpaceX (SPCX.O) est à la recherche de milliers de sites de téléphonie mobile. AT&T (T.N) , Verizon (VZ.N) et T-Mobile (TMUS.O) ont cédé respectivement 7,95%, 1,26% et 7,71%, tandis que SpaceX a progressé de 1,89%. Les opérateurs de gestion des infrastructures mobiles comme Crown Castle (CCI.N) et American Tower (AMT.N) ont bondi respectivement de 9,13% et 4,07%. Le secteur de l'énergie (.SPNY) a pris 2,51%, touchant en séance un niveau record à 1.071,51 points alors que le baril de pétrole Brent a grimpé dans les échanges à un sommet depuis fin avril, à 117,45 dollars, à la suite des attaques des Houthis en Arabie saoudite. Cela a ravivé les craintes d'une nouvelle perturbation des approvisionnements énergétiques en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Sur le marché obligataire, le rendement deq bons du Trésor à dix ans a pris 4,7 points de base, à 5,00%, au lendemain de sa plus forte baisse quotidienne depuis près de quatre ans, en lien avec les inquiétudes concernant le caractère durable du redressement des actions liées à l'IA. Aux changes, le dollar (.DXY) affiche une hausse de 0,19% face à un panier de devises de référence alors que les investisseurs sont à l'affût d'indices quant à l'orientation future de la politique monétaire de la Fed. Les contrats à terme sur les fonds fédéraux montrent que les opérateurs ont réduit leurs paris sur une hausse des taux directeurs en décembre après la chute jeudi des marchés boursiers, mais ils évaluent toujours à 81% la probabilité d'une telle mesure, selon les données de LSEG.

item.title: Dale Brown dies at 90; coach turned LSU into national power
item.description: Dale Brown, who guided LSU men's basketball to two Final Fours in the 1980s and transformed the program into a national power during his 25-year coaching tenure in Baton Rouge, died Friday, the university announced. He was 90.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dale Brown, who guided LSU men's basketball to two Final Fours in the 1980s and transformed the program into a national power during his 25-year coaching tenure in Baton Rouge, died Friday, the university announced. He was 90. Brown guided the Tigers to the national semifinals in 1981 and 1986. They lost to the eventual national champion both times: to Indiana in ‘81 and Louisville in ‘86. The Tigers made 13 NCAA Tournaments in all during Brown's time in charge. LSU's most famous alums under Brown are Shaquille O'Neal and Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf (formerly Chris Jackson), who added their names to program lore alongside Pete Maravich. But the program's greatest team successes, the Final Fours, came with future NBA players such as Rudy Macklin, Howard Carter, John "Hot Plate" Williams and Nikita Wilson leading the way. Brown came to Baton Rouge from Washington State in 1972. It was his first and, as it turned out, only head coaching job in the North Dakota native's career. He compiled a 448-301 record (.598 winning percentage) overall, and his teams went 238-200 in Southeastern Conference play. The Tigers won four SEC regular-season championships (1979, 1981, 1985, 1991) and one SEC Tournament title (1980) under Brown. Brown's coaching ability, gift of gab and charisma made him a national figure, but the latter two also made him an enemy of the NCAA in the 1980s and ‘90s. Brown spoke out strongly against the association, branding its officials as hypocrites and, famously, the Gestapo, for its heavy-handedness regarding benefits to players. The NCAA took away two scholarships from the program in 1986 after it found LSU guilty of 16 violations. Brown met his coaching end a decade later after another run-in with the NCAA. At the time, the association was investigating the program over a $5,000 payment made by an LSU booster to former player Lester Earl. The NCAA found no evidence that Brown was directly involved in the payment, but the program was placed on probation in 1998 nonetheless. Brown retired in 1997. Those incidents did not tarnish Brown's legacy entirely. He was inducted into the Louisiana Sports Hall of Fame in 1999, the LSU Athletics Hall of Fame in 2013 and the National Collegiate Basketball Hall of Fame in 2014. This week, he was announced as the 2027 recipient of the John R. Wooden Legends of Coach Award. --Field Level Media

item.title: Soja sobe em Chicago com vendas para exportação dos EUA e alta do petróleo
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que as vendas para exportação dos EUA compensaram o impacto da pressão da colheita, e o setor de energia também contribuiu para a alta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que as vendas para exportação dos EUA compensaram o impacto da pressão da colheita, e o setor de energia também contribuiu para a alta. O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) informou que as vendas líquidas de soja dos EUA na semana encerrada em 15 de outubro totalizaram 2.841.200 toneladas métricas, um aumento significativo em relação à média das quatro semanas anteriores, mas em linha com as expectativas do mercado, que variavam entre 1,8 milhão e 3 milhões de toneladas. O USDA informou na quinta-feira que os exportadores venderam 202.000 toneladas métricas de soja para a China com entrega prevista para a safra 2026/2027. Os preços do petróleo subiram nesta sexta-feira, com o petróleo Brent atingindo seu maior nível desde o início de maio, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no abastecimento do Oriente Médio, onde as autoridades dos Emirados Árabes Unidos também relataram um vazamento de petróleo. Alguns agricultores dos EUA estavam concluindo a colheita de soja após um período de clima favorável no Meio-Oeste e passavam a colher milho, segundo analistas. O contrato de soja novembro fechou com alta de 3,50 centavos, a US$12,565 por bushel. Já o milho fechou em baixa com o avanço da colheita. O contrato dezembro encerrou em queda de 4,50 centavos, a US$4,56 o bushel. O trigo terminou praticamente estável, a US$6,25 o bushel. (Por Renee Hickman)

item.title: La IndyCar vuelve a Europa tras 20 años de ausencia con una carrera en casa para Palou
item.description: La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes. La carrera supondrá el regreso a casa del español Alex Palou, cinco veces campeón de la IndyCar, que nació cerca de Barcelona. La última vez que la IndyCar compitió en Europa fue en el circuito de Assen, en Países Bajos, en 2007. El campeonato no ha disputado ninguna carrera fuera de Norteamérica desde 2013, cuando se celebró una prueba en Brasil. Palou, de 29 años, ha ganado los últimos cuatro títulos de IndyCar y también se alzó con la victoria en las 500 Millas de Indianápolis en 2025. El Circuito de Cataluña acogió este año una prueba de Fórmula 1, pero desaparece del calendario en 2027 y se alternará con Bélgica hasta 2032. "Llevamos años siendo testigos de su extraordinario talento (el de Palou) y sabemos que sus seguidores en España están deseando verle competir en directo", dijo Mark Miles, director general de Penske Entertainment Corp., propietaria de IndyCar. "Es una oportunidad increíble, y para mí significa mucho poder correr en casa, en Barcelona; es difícil expresarlo con palabras. Sé que a los aficionados les va a encantar, y creo que vamos a ofrecer un gran espectáculo", dijo Palou. La carrera de 2027 se celebrará del 16 al 18 de julio.

item.title: Colombiano Ecopetrol estima utilidad neta de 4 a 5 billones de pesos en el tercer trimestre
item.description: La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes. En el segundo trimestre, Ecopetrol registró una ganancia neta de 6,06 billones de pesos (1.902 millones de dólares). De acuerdo con la actualización operativa de la compañía publicada en su página de internet, los ingresos totales se habrían situado en un rango de 33 a 36 billones de pesos (10.361 a 11.302 millones de dólares) en el periodo de julio a septiembre. Ecopetrol no suministró ninguna variación porcentual de las proyecciones. Por su parte, la producción en el tercer trimestre habría alcanzado un rango de entre 740.000 y 750.000 barriles equivalentes de petróleo promedio día (bpd). Las proyecciones de Ecopetrol supondrían un incremento en la producción frente a los 705.800 bpd del segundo trimestre de 2026. Ecopetrol, controlada mayoritariamente por el Estado, es la empresa más grande de Colombia, produce la mayor parte del petróleo del país y posee las dos principales refinerías y gran parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos. (1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos colombianos).

item.title: Swiss drug developer Windward Bio files for US IPO
item.description: Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings. Biotech has been one of the more active sectors in this year's fall IPO market, even as rising bond yields and concerns around the AI trade weigh on broader risk appetite.
